newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish July T-bill auction draws higher rates.
newsitem.headline: Danish July T-bill auction draws higher rates.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Wednesday its monthly treasury bill auction resulted in minimum rates of 3.65 percent for the six-month series and 3.75 percent for the nine-month series.
One month ago, the six-month series, at that time with a maturity of seven months, yielded 3.60 percent, with the nine- month series, then with 10 months' maturity, yielding 3.70 percent.
The central bank said it sold 0.9 billion crowns worth of the six-month series and 1.7 billion crowns worth of the nine-month paper, giving a total of 2.6 billion crowns.
